4. DESCRIPTION
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued.
The solicitation number is 36C24927Q0014. This solicitation is issued as a Request for Quotations (RFQ) for commercial services.
The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2025-03, effective January 17, 2025, as well as applicable VAAR deviations, VA Acquisition Manual guidance, and VA policy updates in effect on the date of solicitation issuance.
This acquisition is set aside exclusively for 100% Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) concerns. The applicable NAICS code is 561990, All Other Support Services, with a small business size standard of $16.5 million.
The Government intends to issue a purchase order or contract to the responsible offeror whose quotation conforms to the requirements of this solicitation and is determined to provide the best value to the Government in accordance with the evaluation procedures stated herein.
This acquisition will be conducted pursuant to the authority of FAR Part 13, Simplified Acquisition Procedures.
5. APPLICABLE REGULATIONS AND CONTRACT CLAUSES
This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses in effect through the applicable Federal Acquisition Circular, including FAR provisions and clauses applicable to commercial services, as well as the current Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) and Department of Veterans Affairs acquisition policies and deviations.

6. REQUIREMENT
The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, transportation, supervision, and other resources necessary to perform secure document shredding and destruction services for Tennessee Valley Healthcare Services and all associated locations identified in the SOW.
Services shall include the collection, transportation, shredding, destruction, and appropriate documentation of Government records and other materials designated for destruction. All services shall be performed in accordance with the requirements of the SOW and applicable Federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
Delivery and service locations are identified in the SOW and include Tennessee Valley Healthcare Services and all properties included therein.
